expectations.text: The output conditionally edits with the last-read expected_revision: it either attempts revision 3 and handles the conflict, or first re-reads revision 4, reviews a merge and saves with that current revision.
expectations.evidence: Re-read the same saved draft; review revision 4 against the version originally opened; save only changed fields with expected_revision: 4 if 4 is still the last revision read.

expectations.text: The output treats a revision conflict as a failed edit, not as success.
expectations.evidence: A save with expected_revision: 3 should return 409. Never bypass that conflict by simply changing the expected revision to 4.

expectations.text: The output re-reads the current draft before proposing a merge or retry.
expectations.evidence: Keep new text locally and re-read the same saved draft; if another edit causes 409, re-read and review the merge again.

expectations.text: The output does not blindly overwrite revision 4 or send the stale revision.
expectations.evidence: Merge while preserving teammate edits; resolve overlapping edits with teammate or user. Saving does not authorise sending; obtain approval of final saved recipients, subject, bodies and attachments.
